A blue line connects black circular data points for each year from 2005 to 2015.
Each data point has a numerical label indicating its temperature value in °C, positioned near the point.

The data point for 2015 is at the bottom of the chart, labeled '10.0°C'.

public_definitions: The task is to review the dashboard for the 2005-2015 period and determine if the full-period change requires substantial-change follow-up.
The options are: Route to substantial-change follow-up, Keep on routine monitoring, or Archive the record.
The routing criterion is whether the full-period mountain snowpack temperature change requires substantial-change follow-up.
